text:
Recreational Flyers

Fixture text. Flying for fun follows the recreational rules.
title: [FIXTURE] Recreational Flyers

text:
Recreational Flyers > Fly at or below 400 feet

Fixture text. In uncontrolled airspace, recreational flyers stay at or below 400 feet above ground level.
title: [FIXTURE] Recreational Flyers

text:
Recreational Flyers > Take the safety test

Fixture text. Recreational flyers pass a free online safety test and carry proof of passing when they fly.
title: [FIXTURE] Recreational Flyers

text:
Certificated Remote Pilots

Fixture text. Flying for work or business is covered by the Part 107 rules.
title: [FIXTURE] Certificated Remote Pilots

text:
Certificated Remote Pilots > Get a remote pilot certificate

Fixture text. A Part 107 pilot passes a knowledge test and holds a remote pilot certificate before flying commercially.
title: [FIXTURE] Certificated Remote Pilots

text:
Register Your Drone > Who must register

Fixture text. Drones that weigh more than 0.55 pounds are registered before they fly. Registration lasts 3 years.

| Drone use | Registration | Fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recreational | One number for all your drones | $5 |
| Part 107 | One number per drone | $5 per drone |
title: [FIXTURE] Register Your Drone

text:
Chapter 2 Weather > Stable and unstable air

Fixture text. Stable air brings smooth flying and poor visibility; unstable air brings turbulence and good visibility.

| Characteristic | Stable air | Unstable air |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Clouds | Stratiform | Cumuliform |
| Turbulence | Smooth | Rough |
| Visibility | Fair to poor | Good |
title: [FIXTURE] Remote Pilot Study Guide

text:
Remote ID > What Remote ID is

Fixture text. Remote ID lets a drone in flight share identification and location information that others can receive.
title: [FIXTURE] Remote Identification of Drones

text:
Remote ID > Ways to comply

Fixture text. Pilots comply by flying a Standard Remote ID drone, adding a broadcast module, or flying inside a recognized identification area.
title: [FIXTURE] Remote Identification of Drones
